items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: And that's, he had six pieces... They had another fella called, uh, Julius Gronison, he was playing bass.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And I was on the bass drum, and another fella called, let's see what his name was. Oh yeah, called him, uh, Albert Silvey. He was playing, you know, you know, they're dead now, they've been dead for many years. I was real young before they died, when they died. And that's why we continued. Finally, we made up a little, an orchestra, you know, six piece. Yeah. And, uh, this fella, what, I call you Jack Paeda, what they call him, he was playing trumpet, and they had me playing snare drum, I mean, trap drum.…
Well, how old were you when you gave it up then, that first time?
